note: Realistic filled-in states in the AAA screening engine's shape. Classified by classifyAaa on maximum antero-posterior aortic diameter (deterministic). `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.flaggedIssues via flagsHint "detectFlaggedIssues" with flagsArgs ["state","result"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.
